summary: The existing vanilla-JS Kanban UI is complete and compatible with the finished backend, including three columns and click-to-move controls.

messages.content: Frontend task is complete: the existing UI provides Todo, In Progress, and Done columns plus create, edit, delete, and status-select movement actions. It uses PATCH, which the completed backend supports.
Frontend behavior is ready for end-to-end verification against GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE `/api/tasks`.

decisions: Keep click-to-move via each task's status selector; it satisfies the requested drag-or-click movement interaction without adding complexity.
Use the API mutation responses followed by a task-list refresh to keep all column counts and cards consistent.
